text.tspan: The mask's 1s mark the network bits: address AND mask = network address
Local or remote? The host ANDs the destination with its OWN mask, then compares
→ remote: send it to the gateway (2.7)
Both addresses start with 192.168.10. but sit in different /26s: do the AND, don't trust how they look.
